verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs state plugin marketplaces provide 'version tracking' and 'automatic updates' (docs-8, docs-36), and plugins support 'versioned releases' (docs-7) — this is the documented update path since skills are commonly distributed as plugins. However, no explicit `/plugin update` (or equivalent) command is shown in the evidence, and standalone skills (installed via SKILL.md folders, not plugins) have no documented update mechanism beyond manual reinstall/copy.  Missing for 10: an explicit update command example, and update-path evidence for bare (non-plugin) skills.
